title: Real Time Sync
description: Syncs Minecraft server time with real world time.
body:
# Real Time Sync

A Fabric mod that synchronizes Minecraft server time with real world time.

## Features
- Real time synchronization with Minecraft day/night cycle
- Timezone support
- Zombie Piglin spawning in Nether portals (disabled by default)
- Easy configuration via commands

## Commands
All commands require operator level 2.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/rts status` | Show current config |
| `/rts sync true/false` | Enable/disable time sync |
| `/rts timezone <-12 to 14>` | Set timezone offset (e.g. UTC+2 for Ukraine) |
| `/rts piglin true/false` | Enable/disable Zombie Piglin spawning in portals |

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API
